note: Initial vocabulary definitions for the connected foundation. These classify structure only; no claim about a real boundary, legal authority or officeholder is made.

schemes.name: Geographic unit type
schemes.description: Kinds of spatial identity; the type does not assert a particular boundary or parent.

schemes.name: Office category
schemes.description: Broad office meaning; a country-specific definition and legal support are separate.

values.label: Country territory
values.description: Territorial area linked to a modern country by a dated country-territory assertion.

values.label: Administrative area
values.description: Area participating in a documented administrative relationship system.

values.label: Electoral area
values.description: Area participating in a documented electoral relationship system.

values.label: Statistical area
values.description: Area defined for a documented statistical system.

values.label: Historical area
values.description: Historically attested or reconstructed area with evidence and uncertainty on its assertions.

values.label: Hypothetical area
values.description: Explicit scenario area excluded from official containment traversal.

values.label: Governor
values.description: Broad label only; powers, selection, mandate and actual office depend on a reviewed domain definition.

topics.name: Population
topics.description: Defined measurements of people with period, coverage and method.

topics.name: Representatives
topics.description: Offices, mandates and independently sourced holder terms.

topics.name: Budget
topics.description: Public resource plans linked to institutions, fiscal periods and coverage.
